method: Assistant presented selected policy passages and answer excerpts in chat; project owner explicitly agreed with each proposed judgment. This is targeted owner review, not independent blind review or full-dataset human scoring.

decisions.off: Semantic error: not guaranteeing immediate return was strengthened into definite non-return or an exclusive full-return prerequisite.
decisions.on: Semantic error: the explanation also introduced a full-return prerequisite absent from the policy.
decisions.classification: Answer interpretation error despite available evidence; both arms fail this boundary.

decisions.off: Accurately preserves that goods return does not automatically return a shipping coupon.
decisions.on: Semantic error: only cancellation permits processing is an unsupported exclusive restriction.
decisions.causal_limit: Both arms reused the same evidence in this turn. No direct causal attribution to expansion from this observation.

decisions.classification: Accepted equivalent evidence was missing from the original annotation; off evidence suffices for this case.
decisions.scope: Case-specific equivalence, not a global rule that general passages replace all category exceptions.

decisions.off: Reasonable clarification; no unsupported affirmative guarantee or fabricated rule.
decisions.on: Same reasonable core conclusion plus supported default stacking rule and exception.
decisions.classification: Explanation completeness improvement, not conclusion correctness improvement.
decisions.scoring_limit: Original checklist score retained; must not relabel 24/26 to 25/26 as a human-confirmed accuracy gain.

not_confirmed: Aggregate business accuracy or answer accuracy improvement
